info.title: Uptime Kuma API
info.description: Manage monitors and read their results. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`.

200.description: One page, ordered by id. Credentials are redacted unless the key also has monitors:write.

201.description: Created. An active monitor is checked immediately.

200.description: Updated. Fields left out return to their defaults.

patch.summary: Update some fields of a monitor

200.description: Updated. Headers and status codes are replaced as a whole when present.

schema.description: Any fields of MonitorInput. `parentId: null` removes the monitor from its group.

delete.summary: Delete a monitor and its history

200.description: Server-Sent Events. Each `beat` event holds a Beat.

get.summary: List the notifications a monitor uses

put.summary: Replace the notifications a monitor uses

200.description: Notifications. Config values are hidden unless the key also has notifications:write.
Config values are hidden unless the key also has notifications:write.

502.description: The provider refused or couldn't be reached

get.summary: List API keys, without the keys themselves

201.description: Created. This is the only time the key is shown.

delete.summary: Revoke an API key, effective immediately

config.description: The provider's settings, using the same field names as Uptime Kuma

isDefault.description: Attach to monitors created from now on

applyToAllMonitors.description: Attach to every existing monitor now

resendInterval.description: Repeat the alert every this many DOWN beats. 0 alerts once.

parentId.description: The group this monitor belongs to

url.description: http and keyword: http(s) URL. websocket-upgrade: ws(s) URL.

acceptedStatusCodes.description: HTTP status codes, or for websocket-upgrade the close codes, by default 1000

expiryNotification.description: Alert before the TLS certificate expires, at the days set in the web UI. Has no effect with ignoreTls.

port.description: port, dns, mqtt, ntp (123), snmp (161), smtp (25), sip-options (5060), radius (1812) and steam

propagateTrace.description: Send a W3C traceparent header to the target

pushToken.description: Push monitors: the secret in /api/push/{pushToken}. 8 to 64 letters, digits, dashes or underscores. Empty makes one on create, and keeps the current one on update. Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

pingCount.description: Ping monitors: replies to wait for

pingPerRequestTimeout.description: Ping monitors: seconds to wait for each reply

packetSize.description: Ping monitors: data bytes per request

dnsResolveType.description: DNS monitors: the record type. PTR needs an IP address as hostname.

dnsResolveServer.description: DNS monitors: comma-separated IP addresses or hostnames of resolvers. port is their port, 53 by default.

dnsLastResult.description: DNS monitors: the last answer. Ignored in input.

jsonPath.description: json-query: a JSONata 1.5 expression evaluated on the response. Empty compares the whole response. Also snmp, on the OID's value.

expectedValue.description: json-query: what the result is compared with

conditions.description: dns, mysql, sqlserver, oracledb and mqtt: conditions as the web UI builds them

manualStatus.description: manual: 1 up, 0 down, 2 or null pending

databaseConnectionString.description: postgres, mysql, redis and mongodb: a URL such as postgres://user:password@host:5432/db. sqlserver: an ADO string or sqlserver:// URL. oracledb: host[:port]/service or a (DESCRIPTION=...). Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

databaseQuery.description: postgres, mysql, sqlserver and oracledb: the query, SELECT 1 (FROM DUAL) when empty. mongodb: a command as JSON, {"ping": 1} when empty.

databasePassword.description: mysql: replaces the password in the connection string. oracledb: the password. Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

mqttTopic.description: mqtt: the topic to subscribe to

mqttWebsocketPath.description: mqtt over ws:// or wss://: the path

mqttSuccessMessage.description: mqtt keyword check: text the message must contain

rabbitmqNodes.description: rabbitmq: base URLs of the nodes' management API

snmpOid.description: snmp: a numeric OID, such as 1.3.6.1.2.1.1.3.0

snmpCommunity.description: snmp v1 and v2c. Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

snmpV3Username.description: snmp v3, which is used without authentication or privacy

smtpSecurity.description: smtp: SMTPS, required STARTTLS, no STARTTLS, or STARTTLS when offered

dockerHost.description: docker: the id of a Docker host, which is added in the web UI

dockerContainer.description: docker: the container's name or id

systemServiceName.description: system-service: a systemd unit, such as nginx. pm2: a process's name or id

sshPassword.description: sftp. Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

sshPrivateKey.description: sftp: a private key in OpenSSH or PEM format. Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

sshPassphrase.description: sftp: the private key's passphrase. Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

sftpPath.description: sftp: a path that must exist

grpcProtobuf.description: grpc-keyword: the text of a .proto file that defines the service

grpcServiceName.description: grpc-keyword: a service, with or without its package

grpcMethod.description: grpc-keyword: a unary method, such as Check or check

grpcBody.description: grpc-keyword: the request as a JSON object. Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

grpcMetadata.description: grpc-keyword: metadata to send, as a JSON object of strings. Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

remoteBrowser.description: real-browser: the id of a remote browser, which is added in the web UI. Unset uses a local Chrome

screenshotDelay.description: real-browser: milliseconds to wait before the screenshot, less than half the interval

cacheBust.description: http, keyword, json-query: adds a random uptime_kuma_cachebuster parameter to each request

ipFamily.description: HTTP and WebSocket: connect only over IPv4 or IPv6. Empty uses either

retryOnlyOnStatusCodeFailure.description: json-query: a query that fails is DOWN at once, without retries

saveErrorResponse.description: http, keyword, json-query: keeps the body of a response with an unaccepted status for notification templates, as heartbeatJSON.response

saveResponse.description: With saveErrorResponse, also keeps the body of accepted responses

responseMaxLength.description: Characters of a saved response to keep. 0 means 1024

authMethod.description: HTTP and WebSocket login. WebSocket monitors can't use ntlm

basicAuthPass.description: basic and ntlm. Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

bearerToken.description: bearer. Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

tlsKey.description: mtls: the client certificate's key, PEM. Redacted for keys without monitors:write.

tlsCa.description: mtls: the CA that the server's certificate must come from, PEM. Empty uses the system's

proxyId.description: http, keyword, json-query: the id of a proxy, which is added in the web UI

domainExpiryNotification.description: Alerts before the domain of the monitor's target expires, on the days set under Settings > Notifications

lastUsedAt.description: Updated at most once a minute
